name: csp-forge
description: Scan a built static site (dist/, build/, out/) or live URL and generate a tight Content-Security-Policy with sha256 hashes for inline code. Outputs header, meta, Nginx, Apache, Netlify, Vercel, Helmet, JSON; --check mode for CI.

paragraphs: Point it at your built static site (dist/, build/, out/) and optionally a live URL. It works out exactly which sources the site loads and generates a tight Content-Security-Policy — either sha256 hashes for static sites or nonce + strict-dynamic for server-rendered apps. Output comes ready to paste for Nginx, Apache, Netlify, Vercel, Express/Helmet or a tag, with optional report-uri / report-to and Reporting-Endpoints for report-only rollouts. Vite and webpack plugins run the scan at build time. --check mode fails CI when your deployed CSP is missing sources or too loose. Zero runtime…
